High yielding milch animals in
backward regions
*21. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANW ARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Chairperson of
National Dairy Development Board
(NDDB) has stated that it is futile to
provide high-yielding milch animals in the
backward districts where infrastructure is
lacking and which have no marketing
scope;
(b) if so, whether Government is aware
that a tribal district V alsad has made
phenomenal progress in milk production
inspite of opinion of National Dairy
Development Programme (NDDP) in 1975-
76 that dairy activities there were
impossible due to its location, illiterate tribal
people and shortage of water, etc., and
(c) whether NDDP would penetrate
deep in Vidarbha to diversify farm-related
activities in this tribal region?
RAJYA SABHA

Effecting ban on Endosulfan
†*22. SHRI SATY A VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the pesticide
endosulfan is banned in 62 countries and a
demand is being made for several years to
ban this in India too;
(b) whether it is also a fact that several
hormonal and re-productivity related
defects are developing due to this
pesticide;
(c) whether it is also a fact that it was
extensively used in tea gardens before 2003
due to which people suffered with fatal
diseases;
(d) if so, the reasons for not banning
such type of dangerous pesticide in India;
and
(e) by when a ban would be put on
it?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

9
Financial assistance to drought
affected States
*23. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY :
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether in the wake of drought in
major parts of the country, the food subsidy
extended by the Central Government to
States, has risen to Rs. 61,000 crores from
Rs. 42,000 crores in 2008-09;
(b) whether his Ministry has already
sent teams of experts to all 12 affected States
in the month of August and the teams have
already submitted their assessment;
(c) if so, whether affected States have
released a sum of Rs. 1600 crores without
going into the feedback reports; and
(d) if so, to what extent the financial
help provided to the States has helped in
tackling the drought in the States?
Ceiling on BPL beneficiaries under
National Food Security Bill
*24. SHRI A. ELA V ARASAN: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has requested
State Governments to put a ceiling on the
number of BPL beneficiaries under Targeted
Public Distribution System for the purpose
of National Food Security Bill; and
(b) if so, the response from State
Governments alongwith details thereof?
Drip and sprinkler irrigation
*25. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that drip and
sprinkler irrigation is rapidly gaining ground
in the country;
(b) if so, the number of hectares covered
under drip irrigation in the State of West
Bengal, district-wise; and
(c) the details of Central subsidy
provided to farmers who adopted drip
irrigation in the State of West Bengal in the
last three years, year-wise?
Ragging incidents in NCR colleges
*26. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of ragging incidents have taken place during
the current year in NCR colleges;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action Government has taken
against the Principals of those colleges and
students found involved in those
incidents?
Suicide by farmers
†*27. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is an increase in the
incidents of suicides and self-immolations
by farmers in different parts of the country
despite the rehabilitation package being in
place;
(b) if so, the number of such incidents
reported during the last two years and
till now in the current year, State-wise;
and
(c) the corrective steps taken by
Government to tackle this problem?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
